snippet.title: Resident Evil 2/3/4 – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Three remakes—Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, Resident Evil 3, and Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition—are coming digitally to Nintendo Switch 2 on October 16, 2026!

Pre-order Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/resident-evil-2-deluxe-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Pre-order Resident Evil 3: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/resident-evil-3-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Pre-order Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/resident-evil-4-gold-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Experience the path leading to the latest installment in the series. Enjoy this saga of survival horror to your heart's content—anytime, anywhere!

#NintendoDirect #ResidentEvil

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
